title: inconsistent path suffix check in queue.rs drain_once
description: queue.rs line 203 checks for .msg.tmp/.env.tmp via 'path.to_str().is_some_and(|s| s.ends_with(...))' while lines 211 and elsewhere use 'path.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "msg")'. The extension() pattern is the style used consistently in cleanup_tmp_files (relay_queue.rs) and in drain_once for .msg. The to_str() suffix check is inconsistent with the rest of the file and the sibling module.
